description: April 1 birthday meaning: Aries decan 2, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 1 birthday falls in Aries, in the second decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Sun as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: The April 1 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: April Fool's Day belongs to a serious pioneer. The Sun is about eleven degrees into Aries, in the Sun-sub-ruled second decan, and day 1 doubles down on initiative. Traditionally this suggests confidence, creative leadership and a talent for being first, with a playful streak that keeps the ambition from feeling heavy.

Astronomically, April 1 puts the Sun near 11° Aries in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Sun. Between 10 and 19 degrees of Aries the Sun takes over as sub-ruler, lending this middle decan some of Leo's warmth and sense of occasion. The Martian drive is still there, yet it is often aimed at something worth being seen for: a cause, a team, a creative project with their name on it. Traditional writers associate this stretch with pride in the good sense, a wish to lead by example rather than by force. Generosity tends to come easily, and so can a sensitivity to being overlooked. A useful question for these Aries natives is whose applause actually matters, since chasing everyone's can scatter a strong fire.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for April 1
paragraphs: Born on the 1st, your birthday number is a plain 1, with no compound behind it. In Pythagorean numerology the day of birth is a secondary number, a talent or flavour that sits alongside the Life Path rather than replacing it. A first-of-the-month birthday is traditionally read as the purest form of initiative: a self-starting streak, a preference for making decisions personally and a comfort with going first. Because there is nothing to reduce, the energy is often described as direct and uncomplicated. The usual counsel is to pair that independence with listening, so leadership does not become lonely.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an April 1 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous April 1 birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 1 is the 91st day of the year (92nd in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Taurus, is usually complete within 19 days, by April 20.

By April 1 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an April 1 birthday are Otto von Bismarck (1815), Wangari Muta Maathai (1940) and Toshirō Mifune (1920).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 1?
faq.answer: April 1 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Aries, which tradition links with Sun.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 1?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 1 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 4 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 1st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 1?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 1, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 1?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on April 1 include Otto von Bismarck (1815), Wangari Muta Maathai (1940) and Toshirō Mifune (1920). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
